get.summary: List authorized project and standalone tasks
get.description: Ticket tasks are excluded. Scope is applied to filters, search, count, ordering and pagination.
get.x-scope: SQL: global OR project membership OR standalone assignee/creator; organization_id NULL is never public

post.summary: Create a project or internal standalone task
post.description: Project organization is derived from projectId. Omitting projectId creates a private standalone task and requires internal global scope. ticketId and organizationId are rejected.
post.x-scope: SQL: global OR authorized project membership; standalone creation requires internal global scope

get.description: Returns 404 for missing or out-of-scope tasks and never exposes ticket tasks.
get.x-scope: SQL: global OR project membership OR standalone assignee/creator; organization_id NULL is never public

patch.description: Context, assignee and status are protected. expectedUpdatedAt enables optimistic conflict detection.
patch.x-scope: SQL: global OR authorized project membership; standalone creation requires internal global scope

post.description: Project tasks require an active project member; standalone tasks require an active internal local user. The row is locked and audited.
post.x-scope: SQL: global OR authorized project membership; standalone creation requires internal global scope

post.description: Uses the seven-state server machine, assignee/leader guards, reasons for terminal changes, row lock and observed status.
post.x-scope: SQL: global OR authorized project membership; standalone creation requires internal global scope

post.description: Locks the active membership, preserves history, records actor/time and is idempotent when already revoked. Access derived from project membership is removed immediately.
post.x-scope: SQL: global/authorized project membership with projects.manage

get.description: The identical scope predicate applies to filters, search, count, ordering and pagination. No files or download URLs are returned.
get.x-permission: tickets.read (active local users also have own scope)
get.x-scope: SQL before count/data: explicit global grant OR active organization membership OR active project membership OR current assignee OR requester; organization_id NULL only matches its requester

post.description: Omit organizationId/projectId for a private standalone ticket. A project derives organizationId. The server owns requester, code, number, year, initial status, assignment, confirmations and timestamps.
post.x-permission: tickets.create (active local users also have standalone own scope)
post.x-scope: Standalone own, active organization membership, active project membership, or explicit global grant

get.description: Returns 404 for missing or out-of-scope tickets. Does not include files or comments.
get.x-scope: SQL before count/data: explicit global grant OR active organization membership OR active project membership OR current assignee OR requester; organization_id NULL only matches its requester

patch.description: Only subject, description and requestedPriority are accepted. Context, requester, assignment, priority, status, resolution, confirmation and system fields are protected. expectedUpdatedAt is optimistic concurrency.
patch.x-scope: SQL-scoped ticket plus operation permission; missing and out-of-scope resources both return 404

post.description: The target UUID must identify an active internal local user. The row is locked and audited.
post.x-scope: SQL-scoped ticket plus operation permission; missing and out-of-scope resources both return 404

post.description: Requested priority remains separate. The row is locked and the mutation is audited.
post.x-scope: SQL-scoped ticket plus operation permission; missing and out-of-scope resources both return 404

post.description: Uses the exact nine-state PostgreSQL machine. Resolution requires resolution text; cancellation and reopening require reason. Clients cannot choose arbitrary states.
post.x-permission: tickets.change_status, tickets.resolve, or tickets.close according to target
post.x-scope: SQL-scoped ticket plus operation permission; missing and out-of-scope resources both return 404

post.description: Only resolved tickets are accepted. confirm closes; reject requires a reason and reopens. The requester is derived from the ticket and never from the body.
post.x-scope: Own requester, active organization scope, or explicit global grant; SQL-scoped

post.description: Only a closed authorized ticket is accepted. The server selects reopened; a non-empty reason is mandatory.
post.x-scope: Own requester, active organization scope, or explicit global grant; SQL-scoped

get.description: The parent ticket must pass SQL scope. Actors without ticket_comments.read_internal receive only client-visible comments.
get.x-permission: tickets.read; internal visibility additionally requires ticket_comments.read_internal
get.x-scope: SQL before count/data: explicit global grant OR active organization membership OR active project membership OR current assignee OR requester; organization_id NULL only matches its requester

post.description: Author, ticket and organization are server-owned. Clients are forced to client visibility. Content is plain text, limited to 10000 characters, and omitted from audit payloads.
post.x-scope: Inherited from the authorized parent ticket

get.summary: Get the currently published diagnostic questionnaire
get.description: Returns only the published ruleset, active questions and options. Scoring rules and points are never exposed.

post.description: The server validates the current ruleset and answers, scores needs, reuses current public/active service_need_links, stores an immutable snapshot and returns no internal scores.

get.summary: Get the immutable diagnostic snapshot associated with an authorized lead
get.description: Uses the same SQL scope as the lead and never recalculates the historical result.
get.x-scope: Identical SQL scope to lead detail; out-of-scope and absent diagnostics return 404

get.summary: Get published and current draft diagnostic versions

put.summary: Replace the editable draft configuration transactionally
put.description: Published versions are immutable. Option rules point only to service needs, never directly to services.

post.summary: Transactionally publish the draft and create the next editable version
post.description: Archives the previous published ruleset, publishes the complete draft and clones a new draft in one transaction.

get.summary: List the administrative local user catalog
get.description: Returns the paginated local authorization catalog. Personal uses type=internal. No Clerk identifiers are exposed and lastAccessAt remains null until real tracking exists.

get.summary: Get one local user catalog record
get.description: Returns one internal collaborator with internal roles, effective PostgreSQL permissions, dual-access indicator and identity synchronization state.

get.summary: List eligible users for an operational purpose
get.description: The server validates the purpose/context combination, resource scope, active status, internal/client boundary, memberships and effective RBAC. Ineligible identities are omitted.
get.x-permission: Purpose-specific: organizations.manage, projects.manage, tasks.manage, tickets.assign, or leads.manage
get.x-neutral-scope: Out-of-scope organization, project, task, ticket, and lead contexts return 404

get.summary: List internal roles assignable by the current actor
get.description: Returns global internal roles whose effective permissions do not exceed the inviter's capabilities. super_admin and client roles are excluded.

post.summary: Replace and resend an internal invitation
Claim an internal invitation with the authenticated Clerk identity
post.description: Accepts only the opaque local invitation UUID. The role is read from PostgreSQL. This endpoint never creates an organization membership.

post.summary: Activate or reactivate an internal collaborator
post.description: Allows pending to active and blocked to active. Active is idempotent; deleted is terminal.
Blocks active internal access without deleting history or client memberships. Protects the last active administrator by effective users.manage capability.
Only existing global roles within the actor's effective capabilities. super_admin and client roles are excluded.

delete.description: Preserves at least one internal role and one active administrator with users.manage. super_admin changes are outside Personal.

diagnosticId.description: Accepted only when source is diagnostic.

Conflict.description: Duplicate, invalid state, incompatible idempotent retry, or concurrency conflict
